Cafés Around Hutan Pinus Pengger

The Dlingo corridor offers a few relaxed coffee stops, including one reported in the Pinus Pengger area. This page gathers choices, when suitable and how to verify status.

Detail

Coffee choices in the corridor

A few cafés and eateries sit around the Dlingo corridor. RRI reported in 2026 that Cantrik Coffee and Eatery is located in the Pinus Pengger area—a reporting note, not a daily confirmation.

Detail

When it suits

  • Midday for rest and hydration.
  • Afternoon to wait for a photo turn.
  • In rain as a sheltered alternative.

Detail

Verify status

Business names and status can change. Ask staff or search directly; this guide gives no rankings.

Do not assume a specific café is always open; confirm before relying on it.

Frequently asked questions

Are there cafés at the Pinus Pengger area?

The Dlingo corridor has a few coffee stops. RRI reported Cantrik Coffee and Eatery in the Pinus Pengger area in 2026; verify its status on the ground.

Is Cantrik Coffee still open?

It is an RRI 2026 report, not today's confirmation. Ask staff or search directly for current status.

Is it suitable for children?

Café areas are generally relaxed, but supervise children at platform edges. Choose a marked safe spot.

What is the coffee price?

Unverified. Ask the provider directly; this guide sets no figure.
